To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Imagenet embeddings are not a good choice for GAN evaluation.

(i) the embeddings of the GANs are not aligned to the Imagenet embeddings, (ii) Imagenet embeddings are a poor fit for GAN evaluation in terms of the FID and Precision metrics and (iii) the Imagenet representations can be replaced with a better choice of representations that are more suitable for GAN evaluation.

1) the embeddings from a CNN trained on ImageNet classification are not suitable for GAN evaluation in non-Imagenet image domains; 2) the embeddings from self-supervised CNNs pretrained on ImageNet do not improve the quality of the representations and are not suitable for the same reasons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: how do the choice of image representation and the evaluation metric influence the assessment of GANs?
